result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers recommend keeping annual as the default while making the monthly price readable, and both get the numbers right. B spells out the costs of the small grey text more fully (refunds, chargebacks, angry reviews, app store complaints, legal exposure) and lists more things to measure: refund rate, chargebacks, billing support tickets, and 30/60-day cancellations. A's math is more complete because it includes the $65.89 dollar saving, but it says less about trust and complaints, and its only measures are refunds and 30-day cancellations. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers recommend clearly that annual should be pre-selected but the monthly price kept readable, and their math is correct. A explains the trust, refund, chargeback and complaint risks more fully and tracks more signals, but it leaves out the $65.89 saving and makes unsupported claims, such as that meditation-app buyers are especially sensitive. B shows every derived figure and invents nothing, but it covers the risks and the metrics more thinly.
